cases.title: Zero-order category silently missing from a monthly report
cases.sql:
SELECT
    c.name AS category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN products AS p
    ON p.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
   AND o.order_date >= '2025-12-01'
   AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY c.name ASC;

cases.title: Individuals leaderboard topped by corporations
cases.sql:
SELECT
    c.full_name AS customer_full_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.entity_type IN (7, 8)
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.full_name ASC
LIMIT 5;

cases.title: Guessed entity_type code returns zero rows dressed as an answer
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.entity_type IN (7, 8)
  AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01';

cases.title: Absolute growth question answered with percentage growth
cases.sql:
SELECT
    c.name AS category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
        THEN o.order_id
    END) -
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'
        THEN o.order_id
    END) AS absolute_increase
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN products AS p
    ON p.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY absolute_increase DESC, c.name ASC
LIMIT 1;

cases.title: Order counts inflated by item-level JOIN fan-out
cases.sql:
SELECT
  c.name AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM categories AS c
JOIN products AS p
  ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.name ASC;

cases.title: Monthly trend missing the month that had nothing
cases.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months(month) AS (
    SELECT '2025-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', month || '-01', '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month < '2025-12'
),
garden_orders AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN categories AS c
      ON c.category_id = p.category_id
     AND c.name = 'garden'
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)
)
SELECT
    m.month,
    COALESCE(g.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN garden_orders AS g ON g.month = m.month
ORDER BY m.month;

cases.title: Top customers ranking swallowed by a NULL bucket
cases.sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(c.company_name, c.full_name) AS customer_display_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_id
LIMIT 10;

cases.title: High-value scope filter dropped, the whole year counted
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
  HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) > 500
) AS high_value_orders;

cases.title: Top-3 ranking with a tie at third place
cases.sql:
WITH product_units AS (
  SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM products AS p
  JOIN categories AS c
    ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE c.name = 'toys'
    AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    product_name,
    units_sold,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS sales_rank
  FROM product_units
)
SELECT
  product_name,
  units_sold
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_rank <= 3
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, product_name ASC;
